p3-p8-01.actual: Franchise (and its staff) could POST /api/messages and /api/messages/from-booking to head office's or a sibling franchise's family; the family received it, the sender could not even see the thread.
p3-p8-01.notes: Now limited to franchiseFamilyEmails / the booking's franchiseId (same rule as /broadcast). Covered by e2e/comms-scoping.spec.ts.

p3-p8-02.actual: A parent's message to the provider emailed head office's address even for a franchise family (the only inbox that family's thread shows in besides HO).
p3-p8-02.notes: Routes to the franchise account inbox (lib/notify franchiseEmail) like every other team alert.

p3-p8-03.actual: GET /api/emails/suppressions returned the whole tenant's unsubscribe list to a franchise, and POST /suppress let a franchise silence head office's families for the whole tenant.
p3-p8-03.notes: Both scoped to the franchise's own families.

p3-p8-04.actual: HQ replies to a franchise's support thread rang head office's bell/inbox, never the franchise's.

p3-p8-05.actual: HQ replies to a parent's own 'Report a problem' thread (providerId null) notified nobody at all: no bell, no email.
p3-p8-05.notes: Bell (email-keyed) + ActivityOS-branded email, honouring the parent's mute.

p3-p8-06.actual: Parent Accidents page 'Stop notifying me' was a localStorage flag the server never read; emails kept coming (medication had been fixed earlier, this one was missed).
p3-p8-06.notes: Now PUT /api/notifications/prefs for accident+incident. Verified live and in e2e/comms-scoping.spec.ts.

p3-p8-07.actual: A parent withdrawing medication consent told nobody on the team (staff found out when the dose button refused).

p3-p8-08.actual: Trip 'send message' wrote back the attendee list it read before sending, wiping any consent given while emails were going out.
p3-p8-08.notes: Stamps 'sent' inside a transaction on the current list.

p3-p8-09.actual: ack-chase sweep read every incident of every tenant every 30 minutes (Firestore reads bill).
p3-p8-09.notes: Range query on createdAt inside the 7-day chase window.

p3-p8-10.actual: Scheduled marketing emails used a recipient list frozen at schedule time, so someone who unsubscribed in between still got it (PECR).
p3-p8-10.notes: Sweep re-applies suppression + explicit opt-out at send time; verified by calling the sweep directly against live data (a live API sweep at 02:26 ran stale code, see open items).

p3-p8-11.actual: Freelancer one-calendar clash error told a parent 'your existing booking APF-xxxx (09:00-15:30 ...)' naming ANOTHER family's booking ref and times.
p3-p8-11.notes: Ref/times only when the clashing booking is the caller's own.

p3-p8-12.actual: POST /api/emails/inbound fell back to the public literal 'dev-inbound' secret in production when INBOUND_EMAIL_SECRET was unset.
p3-p8-12.notes: Closed (401) in production when unset; DEPLOY.md updated.

p3-p8-13.actual: Any provider could tag ANY childId in a Moment: that family got a 'new moment featuring ...' bell + email from a provider they never booked, and the caption showed in their feed.
p3-p8-13.notes: POST/PUT /api/moments require the child to be booked with the caller (franchise-scoped).

p3-p8-14.actual: HQ bell: support notification id was the bare thread id, so once HQ had opened the bell every later message in that (single, ongoing) thread stayed 'read' forever; HQ's own reply also re-appeared as 'New support message'.
p3-p8-14.notes: Id includes the last message time; threads whose last message is HQ's are omitted.

p3-p8-15.actual: Setup -> Notifications never offered the 'listing ended' and 'stock low' switches although the server honours both keys.

p3-p8-16.actual: Bell scoping matrix live: company sees all (franchise-tagged too), franchise only its own tagged alerts, plain staff only day-to-day categories and never booking/billing/incident, freelancer only its own tenant, parent only its own email; read state per person for franchise/staff (staff read-all did not clear the owner's); cross-tenant mark-read ids marked 0.

p3-p8-17.actual: Setup Notifications toggles live: 'bell' = bell without email, key false = no bell, email-delivery false = bell without email; default = bell + email attempt (emailStatus suppressed while MAIL_LIVE is off).

p3-p8-18.actual: Parent mute honoured per category: accident/medication 'given' -> bell + emailStatus muted; missed dose ignores mute (safety) and is attempted; unmute restores.

p3-p8-19.actual: Leave: staff request -> owner bell only (not franchise, not staff); decision -> that staff member's own bell + email. DSL alert for a franchise child goes to the franchise account holder only, details-free. Platform bell 403 for non-platform.

p3-p8-20.actual: Messaging isolation: parent A cannot open parent B's thread, freelancer cannot read company threads, plain staff cannot read threads it never wrote in, parent cannot use operator settings/broadcast/email send, staff cannot email-send, bad pref category 400.

p3-p8-21.actual: e2e/comms-scoping.spec.ts 3/3 passed via scripts/e2e-locked.sh (franchise scoping, HQ reply routing, server-side accident mute).

p3-p8-22.actual: PUT /api/messages/settings wrote the shared TENANT doc for a franchise too: a franchise could set head office's notifyEmail (where every head-office booking / safeguarding / incident alert email goes) or switch its message emails off.
p3-p8-22.notes: A franchise's switches now live on its own account (users/{uid}); its alerts and family messages honour them. Verified live: company settings unchanged after a franchise PUT.

p3-p8-23.actual: GET /api/messages/broadcasts returned head office's bulk-send history (with up to 500 recipient names+emails each) to a franchise.
p3-p8-23.notes: Broadcast records carry franchiseId; a franchise sees only its own (older records stay head-office only).

p3-p8-24.actual: A conversation HQ STARTS (POST /api/platform/support) notified nobody: no bell, no email, no unread flag on the provider/parent side.
p3-p8-24.notes: Same notifier as a reply (title 'Message from ActivityOS support') + unreadByUser.

p3-p8-25.actual: Expense claim from a franchise's staff alerted head office only; the franchise manager who approves it was never told.

p3-p8-26.actual: Alert emails to a franchise's inbox linked into /company/... (the tenant's portal), which the franchise account cannot open (one account = one portal).
p3-p8-26.notes: Email link rewritten to /franchise/... when the franchise inbox is the recipient.

p3-p8-27.actual: A staff member's calendar-reminder bell entry deep-linked to /staff/calendar (no such view) = 404.

p3-p8-28.actual: Nothing throttled a parent's POST /api/messages although each one emails the provider's inbox.
p3-p8-28.notes: 30 sends/min/IP (429 beyond); header RateLimit-Remaining verified live.

p3-p8-29.actual: 'New message from a parent' email button went to the bare site root.
p3-p8-29.notes: Links to /<portal>/messages of the inbox owner.

p3-p8-30.actual: Regression: email-compliance scheduled 'one' send re-run manually (delivered=1), broadcast + listing-recipients, trips send-message live (attendee 'sent' stamped, consent preserved).
p3-p8-30.notes: The first e2e-locked regression run had 2 email-compliance tests fail on 'fetch failed' while the API was hot-reloading, and a scheduled-send test failed with delivered 0 during a reload; all re-verified by probe.

p3-p8-31.actual: messages-broadcast.spec.ts fails when the standing parent already has a VISIBLE (deliberate 1:1) thread with the company: the broadcast body then legitimately shows in the inbox. My probes had created such a thread (cleaned up afterwards).
p3-p8-31.notes: Spec precondition, not a product bug; the spec should clear the thread first or use a fresh parent.

p3-p8-32.actual: e2e/comms-ui.spec.ts 4/4 via scripts/e2e-locked.sh: parent bell badge -> panel -> deep link to /custdash/accidents -> badge clears; company booking alert deep-links to that booking; staff and franchise bells never show head office's booking alert.

p3-p8-33.actual: Resend's log showed REAL sends of session reminders and scheduled campaigns to e2e-*@activityos-test.com (a domain that does not resolve) on 29 Sept, even though the local API is MAIL_LIVE=0: some other instance sharing this Firestore runs the sweeps with mail live (and older code).
p3-p8-33.notes: lib/mailer.ts now never mails that domain unless the exact address is in MAIL_ALLOWLIST. OPEN for Kaz/Amir: find and stop (or redeploy) that other instance - it also emails real addresses from test data (e.g. 'Overdue: TEST' to a real support address) and runs pre-fix sweep code.
